title: Meitei groups hold rally in Imphal; Manipur CM's resignation, abrogation of SoO truce pact sought

ai.summary: Meitei groups held a rally in Imphal demanding Chief Minister's resignation over ethnic violence and scrapping the SoO truce pact with militant groups.

facts.claim: Meitei groups held a rally in Imphal
facts.quote: An umbrella body of Meitei groups held a massive rally in Manipur's capital city on Saturday (October 31, 2026)

facts.claim: demanding Chief Minister's resignation over continued violence
facts.quote: We seek the resignation of the present government for its failure to protect the lives and properties of the indigenous people of the State.

facts.claim: scrapping the SoO truce pact with militant groups

ai.background_note: Manipur has been in ethnic conflict between Meitei and Kuki communities since May 2023, claiming at least 306 lives. The SoO agreement, which expired on September 4 without renewal, has been central to addressing Kuki-Zo insurgency but faces compliance issues.
